## Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`) {#sec-ch03-gnomonic}

### Summary

The cubed sphere covers a spherical shell with six panels, each the gnomonic projection of one face of a cube.
On a panel the two horizontal coordinates are angles, and their coordinate lines meet at an angle that is a right
angle only on the panel's centre lines. snapy computes every measure of a cell exactly from this geometry: the
radial face area, the volume and the two lateral face areas. Velocities are carried in the non-orthogonal panel
frame, and the momentum equation gains curvature sources that keep a uniform pressure at rest.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Exact solid angles, @eq-ch03-gnomonic-solidangle, and volumes, @eq-ch03-gnomonic-volume, of a gnomonic panel cell.

**Data.** In: faces in $r$ [m], $\xi$[^rg-788c4c144f03] and $\eta$ [rad]. Out: areas [m$^2$], volumes [m$^3$], panel cosines and sines.

**Placement.** Metric at setup (`reset`); curvature sources in every stage.

**Activation.** `geometry/type: gnomonic-equiangle` with `distribute/layout: cubed-sphere`; needs `nx2 == nx3`.

**Guarantee / limits.** Measures exact; six panels sum to $4\pi$ steradians.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch03-gnomonic-tests: `test_cubed_sphere_cell_volume_python`, `test_radial_face_moments.release`.
:::

Local symbols: $\xi, \eta\in[-\pi/4,\pi/4]$ the panel angles $x_2$, $x_3$ [rad]; $X=\tan\xi$, $Y=\tan\eta$,
$C=\sqrt{1+X^2}$, $D=\sqrt{1+Y^2}$, $Q=\sqrt{1+X^2+Y^2}$ [-] (the code's `delta` is $Q$); $\hat{\mathbf u}=(1,X,Y)/Q$
the unit position vector in the panel's frame [-]; $\psi$ the angle between the $\xi$ and $\eta$ coordinate lines
[rad]; $\varpi_{jk}$ the solid angle of a cell [sr]; $r_\pm$ the radii of the cell's $x_1$ faces [m]. The
underline marks a covariant component.

### Derivation

#### The panel metric

The point $(\xi,\eta)$ of a panel is the unit vector $\hat{\mathbf u}=(1,X,Y)/Q$. `cs_metric_at`
({{< code src/coord/cubed_sphere_utils.cpp cs_metric_at >}}) returns $X$, $Y$, $Q$, $C$[^rg-b71b7096829d] and $D$ at given angles.
The tangent vectors along $X$ and $Y$ are

$$
\frac{\partial\hat{\mathbf u}}{\partial X}=\frac{(-X,\ D^2,\ -XY)}{Q^3},\qquad
\frac{\partial\hat{\mathbf u}}{\partial Y}=\frac{(-Y,\ -XY,\ C^2)}{Q^3},
$$

with lengths $D/Q^2$ and $C/Q^2$ and dot product $-XY/Q^4$ (using $C^2D^2=Q^2+X^2Y^2$). The angle between them is
therefore

$$
\cos\psi=-\frac{XY}{CD},\qquad \sin\psi=\frac{Q}{CD}.
$$ {#eq-ch03-gnomonic-angle}

@eq-ch03-gnomonic-angle is evaluated in `GnomonicEquiangleImpl::reset`
({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::reset >}}) at cell centres (`cosine_cell_kj`,
`sine_cell_kj`) and at the $x_2$ and $x_3$ faces (`cosine_face2_kj`, `cosine_face3_kj` and their sines). `[G4]`
checks the lengths, the cosine and $\cos^2\psi+\sin^2\psi=1$. The cosine is 0 on the centre lines and $\pm1/2$
at the panel corners (@fig-ch03-gnomonic-cosine).

#### Covariant and contravariant components

A horizontal velocity $\mathbf v_h=v_2\hat{\mathbf t}_\xi+v_3\hat{\mathbf t}_\eta$ along the unit tangents has
covariant components $v_{\underline a}=\mathbf v_h\cdot\hat{\mathbf t}_a$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
v_{\underline 2}&=v_2+v_3\cos\psi,\\
v_{\underline 3}&=v_3+v_2\cos\psi,\\
v_2&=\frac{v_{\underline 2}-v_{\underline 3}\cos\psi}{\sin^2\psi},\\
v_3&=\frac{v_{\underline 3}-v_{\underline 2}\cos\psi}{\sin^2\psi}.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch03-gnomonic-lower}

@eq-ch03-gnomonic-lower is `coord_vec_lower_impl`
({{< code src/coord/coord_utils_impl.h coord_vec_lower_impl >}}) and `coord_vec_raise_impl`
({{< code src/coord/coord_utils_impl.h coord_vec_raise_impl >}}). The stored momenta are covariant and the
primitive velocities contravariant; the conversion is @sec-ch02-laws's.

#### The solid angle of a cell

The solid angle element of the projection is $\lvert\partial_X\hat{\mathbf u}\times\partial_Y\hat{\mathbf u}\rvert
\,\mathrm dX\,\mathrm dY=\mathrm dX\,\mathrm dY/Q^3$. The function $\arctan(XY/Q)$ is an antiderivative of $1/Q^3$
in both variables:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\partial_X\arctan\frac{XY}{Q}&=\frac{Y}{C^2Q},\\
\partial_Y\frac{Y}{C^2Q}&=\frac{Q^2-Y^2}{C^2Q^3}=\frac{1}{Q^3}.
\end{aligned}
$$

So the solid angle of the cell $[X_{j-1/2},X_{j+1/2}]\times[Y_{k-1/2},Y_{k+1/2}]$ is the corner sum

$$
\varpi_{jk}=\sum_{a,b\in\{\pm\}}ab\,\arctan\frac{X_{j+a/2}\,Y_{k+b/2}}{\sqrt{1+X_{j+a/2}^2+Y_{k+b/2}^2}} .
$$ {#eq-ch03-gnomonic-solidangle}

@eq-ch03-gnomonic-solidangle is `solid_angle_kj` in `GnomonicEquiangleImpl::reset`
({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::reset >}}). Over a whole panel the corner sums
telescope to the four panel corners, where $X^2=Y^2=1$ and each corner adds $\arctan(1/\sqrt3)=\pi/6$; a panel is
$2\pi/3$ and six panels are $4\pi$ (`[G5]` checks the antiderivative, the element and the panel total).

#### Volumes and face areas

With $\varpi_{jk}$ the radial face area and the volume are exact integrals of $r^2$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
A_{i\pm1/2}&=r_\pm^2\,\varpi_{jk},\\
V_i&=\tfrac13\Delta x_{1,i}\bigl(r_+^2+r_+r_-+r_-^2\bigr)\varpi_{jk}=\tfrac13\bigl(r_+^3-r_-^3\bigr)\varpi_{jk}.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch03-gnomonic-volume}

@eq-ch03-gnomonic-volume is `GnomonicEquiangleImpl::face_area1`
({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::face_area1 >}}) and
`GnomonicEquiangleImpl::cell_volume` ({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::cell_volume >}}),
which writes the volume without the cancelling difference of cubes, so thin shells keep their digits (`[G6]`).

An $x_2$ face lies in a plane through the centre, so it is a planar annular sector. Its area is
$\int r\,\mathrm dr=\tfrac12(r_+^2-r_-^2)=\bar r\,\Delta x_1$ times the angle the face subtends along $\eta$. That
angle is the angle between the two face corners $(1,X,Y_1)$ and $(1,X,Y_2)$:

$$
\cos\theta=\frac{1+X^2+Y_1Y_2}{\sqrt{1+X^2+Y_1^2}\,\sqrt{1+X^2+Y_2^2}} .
$$

`GnomonicEquiangleImpl::face_area2` ({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::face_area2 >}})
multiplies `x1v * dx1f` by that angle (`dx3f_ang_face2_kj`); the $x_3$ face is the same with the roles of $X$
and $Y$ exchanged. The angle is written once for both panels of a seam, so a seam face has one value on both
sides whichever of $x_2$, $x_3$ is held fixed on each.

#### The curvature sources

The momentum rows of a non-orthogonal panel gain sources from the turning of the tangent vectors. For the $x_2$
row the code applies, per cell,

$$
\partial_tm_{\underline 2}+\dots=\frac{\Delta_j\bigl[A\sin\psi\bigr]}{V_i}\bigl(p+\rho v_3^2\sin^2\psi\bigr)
-\frac{\rho v_1v_{\underline 2}}{r},
$$ {#eq-ch03-gnomonic-src2}

where $\Delta_j[A\sin\psi]$ is the difference over the cell of the $x_2$ face area times the face sine.
@eq-ch03-gnomonic-src2 is `x_ov_rD_kji` and `src2` in `GnomonicEquiangleImpl::forward`
({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::forward >}}), with the last term in
`GnomonicEquiangleImpl::x1_mass_source_`
({{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::x1_mass_source_ >}}). The coefficient tends to
$-X/(rD)$ as the cell shrinks: per unit $\mathrm d\eta$ the $x_2$ face has the arc rate $C/Q^2$ and the sine
$Q/(CD)$, whose product is $1/(QD)$; its $X$ derivative divided by the solid-angle density $1/Q^3$ is $-X/D$, and
the radial measures leave $1/r$ (`[G7]`). Writing the coefficient as a discrete difference of the same face
quantities the fluxes use is what makes a uniform pressure at rest balance in the discrete equations; part (c)
of `test_cubed_sphere_cell_volume_python` measures that balance. The $x_3$ row is the same with $\xi$ and $\eta$,
$X$ and $Y$, $C$ and $D$ exchanged.

Exact and truncated: @eq-ch03-gnomonic-angle to @eq-ch03-gnomonic-volume are exact; the sources of
@eq-ch03-gnomonic-src2 are consistent with the continuous ones to the order of the cell size, a statement this
section derives only in the limit, not as a measured order.

### Numerical method

The metric is built once per block in `reset`, from the block's own panel (`panel_of(rank)`) and the global faces
sliced as in @sec-ch03-globalgrid. The radial direction follows the rules of @sec-ch03-cartesian, including a
stretched $x_1$. The face moments of a radial face are @sec-ch03-facemoments's. The panel-edge ghosts are
interpolated across the seams (@sec-ch03-csinterp) at the order `cells/interp_order`, 2 (linear) or 4 (cubic).

Each $x_2$ and $x_3$ Riemann problem is solved in a local orthonormal frame of its face: the face states are
transformed before the solve with the face metric, and the fluxes back after it (`prim2local2_` and
`flux2global2_`, {{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::prim2local2_ >}}). In the radial
curvature sources of `forward` the C++ local `radius`[^rg-de142f472665] is the cell-centre `x1v`, which on this grid is the face
midpoint, not the volume centroid. The corrected-PE[^rg-d5e077ac54b1] gravity work of @sec-ch06 runs on this grid with the
`radial_mid` measure, which accounts for that midpoint (`x1_measure`, {{< code src/hydro/gravity_work.hpp x1_measure >}}).

#| fig-alt: "Contour map of cos psi over xi and eta from minus pi/4 to pi/4, zero along the axes and largest in magnitude at the corners."

### Code

**A minimal input.**

<!-- reader glossary keys -->Keys in this fragment: `x3min_pi`[^rg-c95e8cfafdcf], `x3max_pi`[^rg-cb56f7532a92], `external`[^rg-f40f85f87106], `x1-inner`[^rg-daddfd12b96a], `x1-outer`[^rg-60952881820b], `x2-inner`[^rg-c7b5a7d38ab1], `x2-outer`[^rg-a0f53b9518db], `x3-inner`[^rg-235afd2e74d2], `x3-outer`[^rg-dbe77d8a94f1].
```yaml
geometry:
  type: gnomonic-equiangle
  bounds: {x1min: 6.4e6, x1max: 6.5e6, x2min_pi: -0.25, x2max_pi: 0.25, x3min_pi: -0.25, x3max_pi: 0.25}
  cells: {nx1: 20, nx2: 24, nx3: 24, nghost: 3}
distribute: {layout: cubed-sphere}
boundary-condition:
  external: {x1-inner: reflecting, x1-outer: reflecting,
             x2-inner: custom, x2-outer: custom, x3-inner: custom, x3-outer: custom}
```

The panel edges name `custom` on `x2-inner`, `x2-outer`, `x3-inner` and `x3-outer`, the built-in no-op, so the
cubed-sphere exchange owns them (@sec-ch03-physfaces).

**What is refused, and why.** `GnomonicEquiangleImpl::reset` stops when `nx2 != nx3`; when `interp_order` is
neither 2 nor 4; and when `interp_order` exceeds twice the ghost count ("Ghost zone size must be at least half of
the interpolation order").

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| panel metric | {{< code src/coord/cubed_sphere_utils.cpp cs_metric_at >}} | `cs_metric_at` | |
| cosines, solid angle, arcs | {{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::reset >}} | `solid_angle_kj` | `gnomonic-equiangle` |
| volume | {{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::cell_volume >}} | `cell_volume` | |
| lateral face area | {{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::face_area2 >}} | `face_area2` | |
| curvature sources | {{< code src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp GnomonicEquiangleImpl::forward >}} | `src2`, `src3` | |

: Tests of the gnomonic cubed sphere. {#tbl-ch03-gnomonic-tests}

`GnomonicEquiangle.area_vol` in `test_coordinate.cpp` prints the areas and the volume and checks only that the
widths are FP64; it asserts no value of the metric. Parts (a) and (b) of the volume test hold to round-off only
when the volume is the exact radial integral times the same solid angle as the radial face area. The
volume test runs on CPU, one process holding the six panels. At the pin every test of the table passes; in the
volume test (a) and (b) are below $10^{-13}$, inside their bound $10^{-12}$, and (c) is below $10^{-10}$, inside
$10^{-6}$. These are round-off and are quoted against their bounds.[^gno-run]

[^gno-run]: [sha: snapy@73c45a7c8c991209924e1137992352c335575062; deck: the tests' own inputs
    (`tests/test_coordinate.yaml`, `tests/test_cubed_sphere_cell_volume.yaml` and the decks the other tests build); run:

    `test_radial_face_moments.release`, `test_panel_rotation.release`, `test_cubed_sphere_seams.release`,
    `test_cubed_sphere_cell_volume_python` and `test_seam_rotation_cache_python`, run together with one anchored `-R`
    pattern, in the `tests` directory of a README CUDA Release build at the pin; CPU, and one CUDA GPU for the CUDA
    cases, 1 rank; Python 3.11.13, torch 2.10.0+cu128, numpy 2.4.6, kintera 2.6.13, pyharp 2.8.2]. 7 of 7 ctests passed.

### Limits

1. **Source order not measured.** @eq-ch03-gnomonic-src2 is shown to have the right limit, not measured for
   order.
2. **No value test of the lateral face areas** beyond what parts (a) and (b) of the volume test imply.
3. **Untested combinations.** Switch-combination coverage is in @sec-ch12-matrix.
